title: Net radiation at the land surface — ef_net_radiation
text: surface radiation balance $$R_n = (1 - \alpha) R_{s\downarrow} + R_{L\downarrow} - R_{L\uparrow}   - (1 - \varepsilon_0) R_{L\downarrow}$$ \(\alpha\) albedo, \(R_{s\downarrow}\) rs_in, \(R_{L\downarrow}\) rl_in, \(R_{L\uparrow}\) rl_out \(\varepsilon_0\) emissivity. last term incoming longwave radiation reflected surface. Assumptions: fluxes instantaneous refer time (satellite overpass); balance one-dimensional (per pixel per point), lateral exchange; emissivity emissivity used obtain rl_out surface temperature. rl_out already contains total upwelling longwave radiation (emitted plus reflected), example radiometer measurement, equivalent call emissivity = 1, removes reflected term avoids counting twice. Missing values (NA, NaN) input propagate corresponding output element, without errors warnings. Diagnostic flags missing inputs assembled orchestration layer, function. Arguments must numeric (double integer) length 1 common length; length-1 arguments recycled. Values outside domain (albedo outside [0, 1], emissivity outside (0, 1], negative rs_in, non-positive rl_in rl_out, infinite value) raise error class earthflux_domain_error (also earthflux_input_error) names argument number offending values.
